forms.ex: Kannst du mir das Salz geben?
forms.exEn: Can you give me the salt?

forms.ex: Ich gebe den Test um zehn ab.
forms.exEn: I am handing in the test at ten.
forms.why: ab = off, away: give it away from you.

forms.clue: to state (details, on a form); to show off
forms.ex: Bitte geben Sie Ihre Adresse an.
forms.exEn: Please give your address.
forms.why: an = on: give the details onto the form. "Show off" is a second sense to learn.

forms.en: give up; post (a parcel); set (homework, a task); place (an ad)
forms.clue: to give up; to post (a parcel)
forms.ex: Gib nicht auf!
forms.exEn: Do not give up!
forms.why: auf = up: give it up (English uses the same picture). A parcel is given up at the counter.

forms.ex: Ich gebe zu viel Geld für Kaffee aus.
forms.exEn: I spend too much money on coffee.
forms.why: aus = out: the money goes out.

forms.ex: Geben Sie Ihr Passwort ein.
forms.exEn: Enter your password.
forms.why: ein = in: give it into the machine.

forms.clue: to give in, to give way
forms.ex: Am Ende gibt er nach.
forms.exEn: In the end he gives in.
forms.why: nach = after: you give way after pushing back, and yield to pressure (a floor or rope also gibt nach).

forms.ex: Ich gebe zu, das war mein Fehler.
forms.exEn: I admit that was my mistake.
forms.why: zu = to, added: add an ingredient; give the point to the other person.

forms.ex: Hohe Bäume umgeben das Haus.
forms.exEn: Tall trees surround the house.
forms.why: um (unstressed) = all the way around.

forms.clue: to hand over formally (keys); to vomit (sich)
forms.ex: Der Vermieter übergibt uns die Schlüssel.
forms.exEn: The landlord hands the keys over to us.
forms.why: über = over: give something over to someone.

forms.clue: to forgive; to award (a prize, a job)
forms.ex: Die Firma vergibt zwei Stellen.
forms.exEn: The company is filling two posts.
forms.why: ver = away: a place that is given away is vergeben (taken). "Forgive" is a sense to learn.

forms.en: yield, show, come to (Die Umfrage ergab …); sich ergeben: arise, follow (from); surrender
forms.ex: Daraus ergibt sich ein Problem.
forms.exEn: That gives rise to a problem.
forms.why: Learn it as a word. Das Ergebnis = the result.

forms.ex: Das ist eine schwierige Aufgabe für uns alle.
forms.exEn: That is a difficult task for all of us.
forms.note: The vowel of the past (gab) and -e: die.

forms.ex: Bitte prüfen Sie Ihre Angaben noch einmal.
forms.exEn: Please check your details again.

forms.ex: Das Ergebnis der Prüfung kommt in zwei Wochen.
forms.exEn: The exam result comes in two weeks.

forms.ex: Wir müssen unsere Ausgaben reduzieren.
forms.exEn: We need to reduce our spending.
forms.note: The singular die Ausgabe also means an edition (of a newspaper) or giving out.

forms.clue: to give back, to return (a purchase)
forms.ex: Kann ich das Kleid noch zurückgeben?
forms.exEn: Can I still return the dress?
forms.why: zurück = back: you give it back.

forms.clue: the return (of goods to a shop)
forms.ex: Die Rückgabe ist innerhalb von zwei Wochen möglich.
forms.exEn: Returns are possible within two weeks.
forms.why: zurück becomes Rück- in nouns: zurückgeben, die Rückgabe.

forms.ex: In der Umgebung gibt es viele Seen.
forms.exEn: There are lots of lakes in the surrounding area.

forms.ex: Mein Arbeitgeber bezahlt mir das Ticket.
forms.exEn: My employer pays for my ticket.
forms.why: Arbeit + geben + -er: the one who gives work.

forms.ex: Der Gastgeber begrüßt alle Gäste persönlich.
forms.exEn: The host greets all the guests personally.
forms.why: Gast + geben + -er: the one who gives a party for guests.

forms.ex: Hast du deine Hausaufgaben schon gemacht?
forms.exEn: Have you done your homework yet?
forms.why: Haus + Aufgabe: a task for home.

forms.ex: Er ist angeblich krank, aber ich glaube das nicht.
forms.exEn: He is supposedly ill, but I don't believe it.
forms.why: What someone has angegeben (stated), but nobody has proven.

forms.ex: Er ist ein Angeber und redet nur über sein Auto.
forms.exEn: He is a show-off and only talks about his car.

forms.ex: Kannst du die Information an alle weitergeben?
forms.exEn: Can you pass the information on to everyone?
forms.why: weiter = on, further: you give it on to the next person.

forms.en: publish, edit (a book); hand over; give (change)
forms.clue: to publish (a book); to give change
forms.ex: Der Verlag gibt das Buch im Herbst heraus.
forms.exEn: The publisher is bringing the book out in the autumn.
forms.why: heraus = out: you give a book out to the public; a cashier gives change back out.

forms.en: editor (of a book, a newspaper); publisher
forms.clue: the editor (of a book, a newspaper)
forms.ex: Der Herausgeber hat ein kurzes Vorwort geschrieben.
forms.exEn: The editor has written a short foreword.

forms.ex: Nach der Eingabe des Passworts startet das Programm.
forms.exEn: Once you enter the password, the program starts.

forms.clue: the handing in (of work); a levy
forms.ex: Die Abgabe der Hausarbeit ist am Freitag.
forms.exEn: The term paper has to be handed in on Friday.

forms.en: handover (of keys, a flat, an office)
forms.ex: Bei der Übergabe der Wohnung bekommen Sie die Schlüssel.
forms.exEn: You get the keys when the flat is handed over.

forms.ex: Bitte begeben Sie sich zum Ausgang.
forms.exEn: Please make your way to the exit.
forms.why: Learn it as a word: a formal verb for going somewhere, heard in announcements.

forms.en: pretend, claim (falsely); set, lay down (a target, a framework)
forms.clue: to pretend (to be ill); to set (a target)
forms.ex: Er gibt vor, krank zu sein.
forms.exEn: He pretends to be ill.
forms.why: vor = in front: you put something in front of others, a pretence or a target they must follow.

forms.en: release, clear (for use); open (a road); approve (a document)
forms.clue: to release, to clear (a road, a file) for use
forms.ex: Die Polizei hat die Straße wieder freigegeben.
forms.exEn: The police have reopened the road.
forms.why: frei = free: you give it free for others to use.

forms.clue: to give someone something to take along
forms.ex: Meine Mutter hat mir Brot für die Reise mitgegeben.
forms.exEn: My mother gave me bread to take on the journey.
forms.why: mit = with: you give it so they take it with them.

forms.ex: Er bat seine Frau um Vergebung.
forms.exEn: He asked his wife for forgiveness.
forms.why: vergeben (forgive) + -ung: the act of forgiving.
